name: pr-workflows
description: Build reviewable PR stacks, write useful descriptions, and understand review comments.

interface.shortDescription: PR stacks, descriptions, and review comments
interface.longDescription: Plan independently green pull request stacks, write concise descriptions, and explain review comments one at a time before changing anything.
defaultPrompt: Split this large change into a reviewable stack of pull requests.
Write a concise pull request description for this change.
Restack these pull requests after their base changed.
Read the review comments on PR #123 and explain them one at a time.
